exposure: Automated SMS text messaging system delivering geographically tailored food resource information
outcome: Usability of the system (Simplified System Usability Scale [SUS])
cohort: English- and Spanish-speaking caregivers of hospitalized children with a positive food insecurity screen, enrolled from a single US children's hospital.
finding: The study found that providing automated, geographically tailored food resource information via text message to families experiencing food insecurity after hospital discharge was feasible, usable, acceptable, and preferred over paper handouts.
